$comment: Public-testnet endpoints + deployed contract addresses for the public E2E mode. Endpoints and contract addresses are PUBLIC (not secrets) and committed here. The funded dev wallet seed is NOT here — it lives in the E2E_DEV_MNEMONIC env (org GitHub secret in CI, .env.e2e.local locally). Address fields are null until the one-time deploy runs (see docs/e2e-testnets.md); the public-mode harness must refuse to run while any required address is null.

mina.$comment: STALE for settlement (#185): this zkAppAddress was deployed WITH init (channelState=1), so its on-chain channelHash = Poseidon(deployer, deployer, 0) — which the connector's claimFromChannel (Poseidon(apex, client, 0)) can NEVER reproduce, so it CANNOT be settled. Before the real settle run, re-deploy BARE (MINA_SKIP_INIT=1) at a FRESH zkApp address via `node scripts/deploy-e2e-mina-zkapp-bare.mjs` (needs E2E_DEV_MNEMONIC + funded treasury + real testnet MINA); that script rewrites this field with the bare address and drops this $comment. See docs/e2e-testnets.md and packages/townhouse/RUNBOOK.md.
